admin.title: Badges, levels and perks
admin.intro: Automatic evaluation runs nightly — changes here apply from the next run, and never touch what anyone already earned.

held.heading: Achievement certificates awaiting release
held.intro: Leaderboard certificates and badges that carry one are prepared held, and reach no one until you release them.
held.selected: {count, plural, one {<bdi>{value}</bdi> certificate selected} other {<bdi>{value}</bdi> certificates selected}}
held.confirmBody: Each certificate appears to its holder, who is notified, and can be verified publicly. After that it can only be withdrawn by revoking it, one at a time.
held.released: {count, plural, one {<bdi>{value}</bdi> certificate released} other {<bdi>{value}</bdi> certificates released}}
held.failed: The certificates could not be released. Try again.

badges.heading: Badges
badges.retireBody: It will no longer be awarded, automatically or by hand. Anyone who holds it keeps it.

award.heading: Award a badge by hand
award.intro: For badges like the annual honour that automatic evaluation never grants. The award is recorded in the audit log with its reason.
award.memberPlaceholder: Type the member's name or email
award.confirmBody: The badge appears on the member's profile and they are notified. It cannot be withdrawn once awarded.

errors.alreadyHeld: This member has held the badge since <bdi>{since}</bdi>.
errors.notFound: The member or the badge is no longer available. Refresh the page.
errors.failed: The badge could not be awarded. Try again.

levels.heading: Levels
levels.note: Lowering a threshold promotes members at the next evaluation; raising one never demotes anyone who already reached it.
levels.thresholdHint: More than the level before it, fewer than the one after.

errors.thresholdInvalid: Enter a whole number, zero or more.
errors.thresholdOrder: The threshold must be above the level before it and below the one after.
